description: This script generates a C/C++ header file 'selected_mobile_ops.h' for selective build configurations in a PyTorch-related project. It processes a YAML file listing operators used by a model, and produces code with macros defining allowed operators and kernel data types.

classes.name: CodeTemplate
classes.description: Template class for generating code snippets with placeholders.

classes.name: SelectiveBuilder
classes.description: Class managing the selection of operators and kernel data types for building.

methods.name: extract_root_operators
methods.description: Extracts root operators from a SelectiveBuilder instance.

methods.name: get_selected_kernel_dtypes_code
methods.description: Generates C++ code for kernel data type selection based on the builder's metadata.

methods.name: write_selected_mobile_ops
methods.description: Writes the selected_mobile_ops.h file with macros for allowed operators and kernel data types.

methods.name: write_selected_mobile_ops_with_all_dtypes
methods.description: Writes the header file with all kernel data types included, given a set of root operators.
